pages.name: Sicilian, Chekhover, 4...Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White give up the queen for a minor piece on c6 (Qxc6); the overview said 4...Bd7 challenges the queen, when it prepares ...Nc6 without allowing the Bb5 pin. Rewrote the overview and plan 3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian, Chekhover, 4...Nc6 5.Bb5 Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 recaptured with a pawn (bxc6) while calling it the bishop recapture; plan 1 exploited doubled pawns Black does not get after ...Bxc6. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3 around 6.Bxc6 Bxc6 with Nc3, Bg5 and O-O-O or c4.

pages.name: Sicilian, Chekhover, 7.c4 Nf6 8.Nc3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a kingside f4-f5 attack with the knight on f3; plan 2 had a ...d5 break that does not fit the ...g6 setup. Rewrote both plans (reviewer caught that ...Bg7 does not hit the d4-queen while the f6-knight blocks); British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian, Chekhover, Main Line, 10.Rhe1
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...h6 and ...g5 with the bishop already on g5. Reworded plan 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian, Chekhover, Main Line, 10.Rhe1 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the queen to h2, which it cannot reach. Rewrote plan 3 around Kb1 and a queen retreat; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Prins (Moscow), 5...e5 6.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight to c4 after c4 had been played. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Prins (Moscow), 5...Nc6 6.c4 Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named the d4-knight's square as a pawn target. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Prins, Venice Attack, 6...Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...b5 with White's bishop on b5. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Prins, Venice Attack, 6...Nbd7 7.Nf5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...b5 with White's bishop on b5 and missed 7...d5, the main reply. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Prins, Venice Attack, 6...Nbd7 7.Nf5 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked a d6-pawn that has advanced to d5; plan 2 called the half-open c-file open. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer rejected calling f5 an outpost while ...g6 is possible) and corrected plan 2.
